name: Example: Computing the Probability of an Event Given the CDF
problem:
Given that the discrete random variable $X$ has the cumulative distribution function $F(x)$ shown in the table below, compute $P(X=5).$

| $x$ | $1$ | $3$ | $5$ | $7$ | $9$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $F(x)$ | $0.15$ | $0.45$ | $0.50$ | $0.90$ | $1.0$ |
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is the function $F(x)$ defined by

$$
F(x) = P(X \leq x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(5) & =P(X\le 5) \\  & =P(X\in {1,3,5}) \\  & =P(X=1)+P(X=3)+P(X=5) \\  & =P(X\in {1,3})+P(X=5) \\  & =P(X\le 3)+P(X=5) \\  & =F(3)+P(X=5).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=5) & =F(5)-F(3) \\  & =0.50-0.45 \\  & =0.05.\end{aligned}
$$
